hero.headline: Build Your Workforce with Confidence
hero.description: EZ Recruitment is an international recruitment and workforce solutions company. We build structured cooperation with recruitment agencies and provide employers with sourcing, screening and coordination for the workers they need, backed by a two-month replacement guarantee and ongoing workforce support.
hero.imageAlt: Abstract graphic of connected points representing an international workforce network

intro.heading: International recruitment and workforce solutions, built around clear commitments
paragraphs: EZ Recruitment is an international recruitment and workforce solutions company. We take on the practical work of recruitment: understanding the requirement, sourcing and screening candidates, coordinating the steps that follow and supporting the workforce after deployment.

We work with employers who need dependable, well-matched people, and with recruitment agencies that want a professional partner for international cooperation. Our approach is straightforward: plan properly, communicate directly and stand behind our commitments.
intro.imageAlt: Abstract graphic of overlapping panels representing structured recruitment planning

services.heading: Our recruitment services
services.intro: Six areas of support that can be combined into a complete recruitment solution or used individually, depending on what your business needs.

industries.heading: Industries we serve
industries.intro: We support employers in sectors where reliable, well-matched workforces make the difference between a project that runs smoothly and one that does not.

why.heading: Why choose EZ Recruitment
why.intro: Hiring internationally involves many moving parts. These are the principles we apply to keep it clear and manageable for the employers we work with.

points.title: Built for employers and partners
points.text: Everything we do is organized around the needs of businesses and recruitment agencies, not individual job seekers.

points.title: A clear, structured process
points.text: Six defined stages take you from your initial requirements to coordinated next steps, so you always know where the search stands.

points.title: Requirements-led screening
points.text: Candidates are assessed against the criteria you set for the role rather than against generic profiles.

points.title: Direct communication
points.text: You work directly with the person managing your search, with an English-speaking representative in each worker group.

points.title: Support after deployment
points.text: A two-month replacement guarantee and ongoing contact with workers continue our commitment beyond the recruitment stage.

points.title: Flexible scope
points.text: Use the full process or individual stages of it, depending on what your business needs and what you already handle in-house.

process.heading: Our recruitment process
process.intro: A defined workflow from the first conversation to coordinated next steps and continued follow-up.

cta.heading: Ready to work together?
cta.text: Whether you are an employer with roles to fill or a recruitment agency exploring cooperation, tell us about your requirements and we will come back to you with suggested next steps.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Straightforward answers to the questions employers and recruitment agencies ask most often.

items.question: What does EZ Recruitment do?
items.answer: We provide international recruitment and workforce solutions. Our support covers workforce planning, candidate sourcing, screening and evaluation, recruitment coordination and ongoing follow-up with recruited workers, for employers and in cooperation with recruitment agencies.

items.question: Who do you work with?
items.answer: We work with employers and businesses, and with recruitment agencies and staffing companies interested in international cooperation. Our services are for businesses and partners, not individual job seekers.

items.question: What is the two-month replacement guarantee?
items.answer: Every recruited worker comes with a two-month replacement guarantee in the event of absconding, giving employers additional confidence and peace of mind. The guarantee applies in accordance with the agreed guarantee terms.

items.question: How do we communicate with the workers we employ?
items.answer: Each workforce group includes an English-speaking communication representative who helps facilitate clear communication between workers and the employer. Our own communication with workers also continues beyond deployment, so they stay informed about instructions and workplace updates.

items.question: Which industries do you support?
items.answer: Our focus is on manufacturing and industrial, food processing, packaging, construction, logistics and warehousing, hospitality, agriculture and facility management. If your sector is not listed, get in touch to discuss your requirements.

items.question: How can a recruitment agency work with EZ Recruitment?
items.answer: Agencies can submit a partnership inquiry through the Partner With Us page. We review it, arrange an initial discussion and, where there is a good fit, agree the scope and responsibilities of the cooperation in writing.

items.question: How do we get started as an employer?
items.answer: Send us an enquiry through the contact page with a short description of your business and the roles you need to fill. We will review it and contact you at your business email to discuss your requirements in more detail.

items.question: What information should we prepare?
items.answer: It helps to have the job titles, the approximate number of positions, the skills and experience required, the work location and your preferred timeline. If some of this is still undecided, we can help you work through it during the planning stage.

items.question: Do you handle visas, work permits and employment procedures?
items.answer: Immigration, work authorization and employment procedures differ by country and role. We coordinate these steps with you and, where a country requires a local authorized provider, together with the appropriate partners within our cooperation structure.

paths.eyebrow: Two Ways to Work With Us
paths.heading: Choose the path that fits your business

agencies.title: For Recruitment Agencies
agencies.text: Build a structured international recruitment partnership. Bring your sourcing strengths and your employer relationships, and discuss how we can cooperate across borders with clear roles and direct communication.

employers.title: For Employers
employers.text: Tell us about the roles you need to fill. We plan the search, source and screen candidates and coordinate the steps that follow, with a two-month replacement guarantee on every recruited worker.

partnership.heading: Build Stronger Recruitment Partnerships
partnership.text: International recruitment works best when everyone involved knows their role. We cooperate with recruitment agencies and staffing companies on sourcing, coordination and long-term workforce projects, with clear communication at every stage.

support.heading: More Than Recruitment. A Commitment to Workforce Support.
support.intro: Recruitment does not end when workers arrive. These are the commitments employers can rely on when they work with EZ Recruitment.

items.title: 2-Month Replacement Guarantee
items.text: Every recruited worker comes with a two-month replacement guarantee in the event of absconding, giving employers additional confidence and peace of mind.

items.title: English-Speaking Group Representative
items.text: Each workforce group includes an English-speaking communication representative to help facilitate clear communication between workers and the employer.

items.title: Ongoing Workforce Follow-Up
items.text: Our communication with workers continues beyond recruitment and deployment. We maintain ongoing contact to help them understand workplace developments, important instructions and relevant updates, supporting smoother communication and more stable workforce relationships.
